column3: “Comes up on your spirit” is rendered “comes into your mind,” and “clans” as “tribes.”
“Bond” follows the Hebrew; the LXX reads “number.”
“And after, if not you will be listening” is rendered “but later, you will surely listen”; the Hebrew is difficult.
MT 21:2. “South” (three Hebrew words) is rendered “Teman,” “the south,” and “Negev.”
MT 21:3. “Forest of the south” is rendered “forest of the Negev.”
